note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the K2 Black Panther. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. It publishes the curb and combat weights, the overall and chassis lengths, the width, the highest and lowest heights, the maximum road speed and the range. It publishes no ground clearance, so that field is absent.
